import.interval: Running/parsing trace to Completed trace, including analysis/publishing/durable commit; UTC log-derived observation, not client upload end-to-end stopwatch

mutation_memory.scope: Exact C1 mutation series; host PostgreSQL sum includes other clusters, not exclusive own PG or physical RAM; finite sampling can miss peaks; lifetime peak separate

journal.assessment: Current taskcards and execution event explicitly retrospective consolidation. Earlier contemporaneous execution journal gap remains a nonruntime traceability limitation; no invented per-task timings or complete historical machine stream.

coverage.scope: Fixed fully loaded available-byte inventory snapshot, not every historical stream or semantic universal PASS
